title: BodyPart
description: A part of a body's model described apart, and the state it is in.

state.description: The id of the state it is in (for a single toggle shown or hidden), null when it can't be told.

stateName.description: The name of that state (see BodyPartState.name), null when it can't be told.

default.description: Whether that is the part's default state.

states.description: The states it can be put in (since 1.5).
